title: Central Portal Chat Agent - Instantiation Config
description: Input form schema used by WSO2 Agent Manager to instantiate the singleton Central Portal Chat Agent for the gov.lk / gic.gov.lk home page.

PORT.title: Port
PORT.description: HTTP port the FastAPI server listens on.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.title: Display Name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Display name for the central portal assistant persona.

ALL_NAMESPACES.title: All Department Namespaces
ALL_NAMESPACES.description: Comma-separated list of KB namespaces searched across when a question isn't scoped to one department.

KB_MIN_RELEVANCE_SCORE.title: Minimum KB Relevance Score
KB_MIN_RELEVANCE_SCORE.description: Minimum KB cosine-similarity score kept when fanning a query out across every namespace. Not applied to an explicitly-targeted single namespace.

WELCOME_MESSAGE.title: Welcome Message
WELCOME_MESSAGE.description: Default opening greeting shown in the chat UI.

SUPPORT_EMAIL_CONTACT.title: Support Email Contact
SUPPORT_EMAIL_CONTACT.description: Fallback contact email when no knowledge base answer is found.

OFFICE_HOURS_INFO.title: Office Hours / Hotline
OFFICE_HOURS_INFO.description: Hotline / office hours shown alongside the fallback contact.

MODEL_TEMPERATURE.title: Model Temperature
MODEL_TEMPERATURE.description: Execution temperature. Kept low for strict factual accuracy.
